statement: Donald Trump and Masoud Pezeshkian meet in person between 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-29, when both are expected in New York for the UN General Assembly high-level week.
resolution: TRUE if the White House or Iranian presidency confirms, or two of Reuters, AP and AFP report, a face-to-face Trump-Pezeshkian meeting held between 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-29. Phone calls, passing handshakes and intermediary talks do not count.
failure_condition: Trump and Pezeshkian do not meet face to face at any point between 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-29.

statement: The US and China announce agreement to establish or launch a dedicated intergovernmental AI dialogue, channel or hotline between 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-30, around the Trump-Xi White House summit.
resolution: TRUE if a White House, PRC Foreign Ministry or Xinhua readout, fact sheet or joint statement issued between 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-30 says both sides agreed to establish or launch a dedicated government-to-government AI dialogue, channel or hotline.
failure_condition: No agreement to establish or launch a dedicated intergovernmental AI dialogue, channel or hotline is announced by either government between 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-30.

statement: US forces carry out at least one strike on a target located on Iranian land territory between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21.
resolution: TRUE if CENTCOM or the Pentagon announces, or two of Reuters, AP and AFP report, a US strike on a target on Iranian soil conducted between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21. Strikes on vessels at sea do not count.
failure_condition: No US strike hits a target on Iranian land territory between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 300 km of 52.859N 171.376W, epicenter of the 2026-09-17 M6.5 event near Nikolski, Alaska, between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query for origin times between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21 UTC within 300 km of 52.859N 171.376W returns at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake occurs within 300 km of 52.859N 171.376W between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21 UTC.

statement: US forces conduct at least one lethal strike on an alleged drug-trafficking vessel in the Caribbean or Eastern Pacific between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21.
resolution: TRUE if US Southern Command or the Pentagon officially announces a lethal kinetic strike on an alleged drug-trafficking vessel conducted between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21; southcom.mil press releases are the primary record.
failure_condition: No US lethal strike on an alleged drug-trafficking vessel occurs between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-21.

statement: ICE Brent front-month (December 2026) crude futures settle below 90.00 dollars per barrel on 2026-10-23. Reference: 100.27 dollars on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the ICE Futures Europe official settlement price of the front-month (December 2026) Brent crude contract on 2026-10-23 is below 90.00 dollars per barrel; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 100.27 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The front-month Brent crude settlement on 2026-10-23 is 90.00 dollars per barrel or higher.

statement: CISA adds at least one new Cisco vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry with vendorProject Cisco and a dateAdded value between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No Cisco vulnerability is added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23.

statement: A federal judge orders the White House to restore access for CNN, Politico or MS NOW journalists between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23.
resolution: TRUE if the US District Court for DC issues a TRO or preliminary injunction, in whole or part, requiring restored White House hard-pass access for at least one plaintiff between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23, per the court docket.
failure_condition: No TRO or preliminary injunction requiring restored White House access for any plaintiff is issued between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-23.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its meeting concluding 2026-10-28. Reference: 3.75 to 4.00 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DFEDTARU, the target range upper limit, exceeds 4.00 percent for 2026-10-29 following the FOMC decision announced 2026-10-28; FALSE if 4.00 or lower. Reference: 4.00 upper limit on the packet date.
failure_condition: The target range upper limit stays at or below 4.00 percent after the FOMC decision of 2026-10-28.

statement: Elif Eralp is elected Governing Mayor of Berlin by the Abgeordnetenhaus between 2026-09-22 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the Berlin Abgeordnetenhaus elects Elif Eralp Governing Mayor in a plenary vote held between 2026-09-22 and 2027-01-29, per the official plenary record or two of Reuters, AP, AFP and dpa.
failure_condition: The Abgeordnetenhaus does not elect Elif Eralp Governing Mayor in any plenary vote between 2026-09-22 and 2027-01-29.
